infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Readis uses your location only when you choose to place or view an incident on the map.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Readis uses the camera only when you choose to attach evidence to an incident or add an image to a community guide.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Readis can access photos only when you choose an image for an incident report or community guide.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Readis to use your location to place incident reports accurately on the map.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Readis to access only the photos you choose for incident evidence or guide content.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Readis to use the camera only when you choose to capture incident evidence or guide content.
